paper_summary.n_decisions: 150 held-out tickets (30 groups), 445 candidate writes in total
paper_summary.text: Refund Arena (200 synthetic single-author tickets; 150 held out in 30 boundary-pair groups): a SQLite dry-run reproduces 445/445 gold labels and a scripted naive doer's first write is forbidden in 60.9\% of 225 writes; the uncalibrated dry-run check certifies a forbidden write on 0 of 150 held-out tickets and 80 of 81 permitted refunds, whereas agnostic RiskGate CRC at $\alpha=0.1$ is valid on average (2.4\% over 200 re-splits) but reaches 17.3\% on the fixed split with 15 calibration groups, and $\alpha=0.05$ is infeasible.
